steps.title: Prepare murine plasma
steps.instruction: Defrost frozen murine plasma on ice and clarify the sample via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plasma at 16,100 g for 10 min at 4 °C

steps.title: Dilute supernatant
steps.instruction: Dilute the supernatant to reduce albumin abundance.

substeps.instruction: Dilute supernatant (1:8) in a buffer containing 75 mM NaCl, 6.85 mM Na2HPO4, and 3.15 mM NaH2PO4 (pH 7.2)
Centrifuge the diluted supernatant at 5,000 g for 5 min

steps.title: Perform heparin affinity chromatography
steps.instruction: Apply the sample to a heparin column to isolate heparin-binding proteins (HBPs).

substeps.instruction: Apply the supernatant to a 1 mL Hi-Trap heparin column (GE Healthcare Life Sciences, 17040601) equilibrated in 75 mM NaCl, 6.85 mM Na2HPO4, 3.15 mM NaH2PO4 (pH 7.2)
Wash the column extensively with 50 mL of modified PBS (150 mM NaCl, 13.7 mM Na2HPO4, 6.3 mM NaH2PO4, pH 7.2)
Elute the heparin-bound fraction using 2 M NaCl in modified PBS

steps.title: Desalt heparin-bound fraction
steps.instruction: Use StrataClean beads to remove high concentrations of electrolytes from the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Mix 100 µg of the heparin-bound fraction with 30 µL StrataClean slurry (Agilent Technologies, #400714)
Centrifuge at 2,000 g for 2 min at 4 °C
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant
Wash the pellet first with PBS
Wash the pellet twice more with H2O
